title: Beige Account: Enterprise ATM Benefits
summary: The document describes Enterprise ATM access benefits: $0.00 Rho fee for out-of-network ATM transactions, monthly rebates up to $50 for out-of-network ATM operator surcharges (capped), and a 1% Rho fee for foreign ATM withdrawals with a $2.00 minimum per withdrawal.
faqs: Is there a Rho fee for using an out-of-network ATM?
How do monthly rebates for out-of-network ATM operator surcharges work, and what is the $50 cap?
What happens if I exceed the $50 monthly rebate limit?
What fee applies to foreign/international ATM withdrawals, including the $2.00 minimum?
Do foreign ATM withdrawals include the 1% Rho fee in addition to any ATM operator surcharge?
How can I maximize Enterprise ATM benefits to reduce fees?
